title: Update header brand link text to ClashRoyalHub

requirements.text: Update the top-left header brand link/label (the button that navigates to Home) to display exactly "ClashRoyalHub".

quotes: Take that link at the top and change it to ClashRoyalHub

acceptanceCriteria: In the global header, the brand label text renders as exactly "ClashRoyalHub" (matching capitalization and spelling).
Clicking the brand label still navigates to the Home page.
No other navigation labels (Home, Beginner Guide, Deck Tips, Discussions, Ask Fred, About, Admin) are changed.

constraints: Frontend immutable paths must not be edited: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui.
Keep all user-facing text in English.
nonGoals: Do not change the HTML document title or other site branding text unless explicitly requested.
Do not modify routing behavior beyond ensuring the brand label still navigates to Home.
